not_applicable_probes.redaction: The Shopalytics fixture declares no redaction surface: every reviewer name, email and location in fixtures/dudulemon/manifest.json is already a shape-preserving synthetic value on example.com, so there is no client redaction policy for a probe to exercise.
not_applicable_probes.side_effect_neutering: The Shopalytics fixture ships no email, payment, webhook, queue or downstream-service adapter, so there is no outbound side effect for a preview sink to replace. The sandbox network policy recorded on the allocation is the only outbound control, and it is asserted separately.
